description:
Meet Tomo, a baby chick who speaks the language you're learning, and only as much as a real child its age.

At 1 year old Tomo uses baby words. Show you understood by tapping the right picture, doing what Tomo asks (feed it, put it to bed, give it a hug), or picking what a word means. Every right answer helps Tomo grow: it hatches, learns two-word phrases, and by 3 starts asking you real questions.

The words come from research on the words children actually learn first, in the order they learn them, from baby talk up to six-year-old vocabulary. Words come back for review just before you'd forget them, so a few minutes a day adds up.

• Learn by understanding, not memorizing lists
• Tap any word to see how it's read and what it means, or open it in the iPhone's dictionary
• Home Screen widgets show Tomo and how many words are waiting
• On the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, Tomo lets you know when new words are ready
• Works offline. No account, no ads, no tracking: your progress stays on your iPhone.

Tomo speaks Japanese today.
promotionalText: Raise a baby chick that speaks the language you're learning, just like a real child its age. Understand Tomo and watch it grow from baby words to real talk.
reviewNotes: No sign-in is needed. This version teaches Japanese to English speakers. On launch Tomo asks a first word: tap the picture or meaning that matches what Tomo says. After the first launch, a Live Activity shows Tomo on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, and the Home Screen widget (small and medium) shows how many words are waiting. All learning content is bundled; the app makes no network requests.
